This is **not** application / Amazon Bedrock LLM cost. Default time range: last 30 days. Run-rate gauges project **30 / 60 / 90 days** from the last 7 days of Cost Explorer unblended spend.

**Elastic Cloud billing:** [Cloud usage and billing](https://cloud.elastic.co/account/billing/overview) · in-cluster **[ESS billing dashboard](https://my-observability-project-f2e495.kb.us-west-2.aws.elastic.cloud/s/finops/app/dashboards#/view/ess_billing-billingdashboard)** (map is region spend, not AWS Cost Explorer). **Inference:** [Token usage dashboard](https://my-observability-project-f2e495.kb.us-west-2.aws.elastic.cloud/s/finops/app/dashboards#/view/kibana-inference-token-usage). **AWS:** [Billing Overview](https://my-observability-project-f2e495.kb.us-west-2.aws.elastic.cloud/s/finops/app/dashboards#/view/finops-aws-billing-overview-unblended). **SLOs:** [AWS daily](https://my-observability-project-f2e495.kb.us-west-2.aws.elastic.cloud/s/finops/app/slos/elk-slo-aws-daily-spend) · [apm-stage daily](https://my-observability-project-f2e495.kb.us-west-2.aws.elastic.cloud/s/finops/app/slos/elk-slo-staging-cost-leak) · [Inference tokens](https://my-observability-project-f2e495.kb.us-west-2.aws.elastic.cloud/s/finops/app/slos/elk-slo-llm-checkout-spend).

Cost Explorer panels filter `group_definition.key` so SERVICE / LINKED_ACCOUNT slices are not double-counted. Account ids are labeled (apm-stage, monitoring, orch). Run-rate gauges use **LINKED_ACCOUNT** unblended spend (not SERVICE — that grouping is incomplete after Sep 3). **Purchase coverage:** amortized vs unblended is the commitment signal; Savings Plans vs EC2 Compute is a SERVICE slice; SP vs the linked-account bill is directional coverage. INSTANCE_TYPE excludes `NoInstanceType` and is incomplete — sit it next to EC2 CPU by type (evidence, not a recommendation). **Usage vs cost:** RDS / MQ / CloudWatch / S3 / Lambda dollars are SERVICE slices. The EKS overlay is **full linked-account spend** for EKS-hosting accounts (stage, monitoring, smartsignal, pss, orch), not the EKS SERVICE line. S3 bytes are `StandardStorage` only. Monitoring and ESF daily SLOs are on the scoreboard.

**Ingest (Elastic Cloud, not AWS):** EKS `kube-apiserver-audit` is rerouted to `logs-kubernetes.audit_logs-default` (~140M docs/day). Remaining EKS control-plane streams stay on `logs-aws.cloudwatch_logs-default`. Fleet CloudWatch Logs is on in all four AWS accounts (all log groups, `us-west-2`). Duplicate control-plane volume raises **project ingest ECU**, not Cost Explorer.
